title: Yeshiva Bochurim Freed
body: Yair Saada, a talmid of Yeshiva Kisei Rachamim, was released from military prison after refusing to report for IDF service. He was greeted by friends with singing, dancing, and a red carpet. Saada was held for 10 days in military custody.

title: Bus Driver Detained Longer
body: Judge extends detention of bus driver suspected of killing Yosef Eisental z”l during Jerusalem protest. Police video reviewed during remand hearing.
